description: War Metal , also known as Bestial Black Metal or War Black Metal , is an aggressive, chaotic, and cacophonous subgenre of heavy metal that fuses first-wave black metal with the brutal intensity of death metal and grindcore. The genre and its associated aesthetic are defined by a primitive, lo-fi, and overtly hostile atmosphere, with lyrical and visual themes centered on war, nuclear holocaust, chaos, and Satanism.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Aggression, chaos, primitivism, anti-religion
